scripted_findings.title: No phone/email found in the raw HTML of 1 page(s) that should carry one
scripted_findings.evidence: 1 page(s) whose URL/role commits them to state a phone/email contain no phone/email-shaped token anywhere in the raw response - not in visible text, JSON-LD, meta tags, or any hydration payload. Examples: ['https://www.notion.com/contact-sales (role=contact)']. Reproduce: curl -s 'https://www.notion.com/contact-sales' | grep -Eo 'tel:|\+?[0-9][0-9 ().-]{6,}[0-9]'

scripted_findings.title: 1 page(s) serve an essentially empty HTML shell
scripted_findings.evidence: https://www.notion.com/contact-sales: 0 words of extractable text, mount element #__next

scripted_findings.title: Brand identity is not anchored to any external profile
scripted_findings.evidence: None of the 12 crawled page(s) declares Organization, LocalBusiness or similar structured data with sameAs links. Without sameAs, an assistant has nothing distinguishing this brand from others sharing the name, which is the standard cause of mistaken identity.

scripted_findings.title: Missing, generic or duplicated <title> on 1 page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: https://www.notion.com/contact-sales: no <title>. The title is the first thing an index stores and the label an assistant shows next to a citation; a blank or shared one gives the page no identity of its own.

scripted_findings.title: Interactive controls without an accessible name on 7 page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: https://www.notion.com/product/ai: 6/129 controls expose no text, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, SVG title or image alt; https://www.notion.com/templates/category/personal: 26/232 controls expose no text, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, SVG title or image alt; https://www.notion.com/templates/category/free-personal-templates: 26/233 controls expose no text, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, SVG title or image alt; https://www.notion.com/templates/category/work: 26/236 controls expose

scripted_findings.title: No Product structured data on 2 product page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: 2/12 crawled product pages carry no Product JSON-LD, so the price, availability and identity of the item are stated only in prose, if at all. Examples: ['https://www.notion.com/product/agents', 'https://www.notion.com/product/ai']. Structured data is read by the indexing crawlers that build the search index assistants query.

scripted_findings.title: No h1 heading on 1 page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: 1/12 pages contain no h1 element at all. Examples: ['https://www.notion.com/contact-sales']. Extractors and assistants use the top heading to decide what a page is about.

scripted_findings.title: No structured data on 3 significant page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: 3/12 crawled pages of type ['about', 'home', 'pricing'] contain no JSON-LD. Structured data is read by the indexing crawlers that build the search index assistants query, and it states a fact with a type attached. Examples: ['https://www.notion.com/', 'https://www.notion.com/pricing', 'https://www.notion.com/about']
